title: Two peaks, both followed by a cliff
label: The numbers
lede: 3DO’s fiscal years ended on March 31. Its 10-K filings on SEC EDGAR cover every year from the first to fiscal 2002; the company went bankrupt before filing one for fiscal 2003. All figures are as first reported unless noted.

blocks.title: Revenue, fiscal 1994 to 2003
blocks.subtitle: $ millions, years ending March 31. The first peak is a license fee. The second is Army Men.

points.title: The console’s first year
points.text: Revenue of $10.3M against a net loss of $51.4M, including a $21.4M charge for buying NTG.[^1]

points.title: The M2 fee
points.text: Of $92.4M (derived), $79.2M is hardware royalties and license fees; Matsushita’s $100M was booked as revenue in stages from fiscal 1996 to fiscal 1998. Software brings in $9.5M.[^1][^4]

points.title: Hardware sold
points.text: Samsung buys the hardware group in June 1997. Software revenue is $9.4M.[^3][^4]

points.title: The publishing peak
points.text: $122.2M, up 154% in a year, and net income of $0.2M.[^5][^6]

points.title: Going-concern warning
points.text: $53.7M of revenue, a $47.3M loss and an accumulated deficit of $251.9M.[^7]

points.title: The last year
points.text: About $30M (derived, unaudited): $20.0M in nine months plus about $10.0M in the March quarter. No annual report was filed.[^8][^13][^28]

blocks.source: FY94–FY96: 10-K for fiscal 1996[^1]. FY97–FY99: 10-K for fiscal 1999; FY97 and FY98 are derived by adding its software and hardware segments[^4]. FY00: 10-K for fiscal 2000[^5]. FY01: 10-K for fiscal 2001[^6]. FY02: 10-K for fiscal 2002[^7]. FY03 is derived from the last 10-Q and a company press release and was never audited[^8][^13]. Later filings restated FY00 to $118.5M and FY01 to $80.0M[^7].

blocks.body: How many 3DO machines were sold is not in the company’s filings. Matsushita, the main manufacturer, gave 300,000 worldwide as of September 1994.[^23] A lifetime figure of about 2 million is widely repeated; we could not trace it to a primary source and treat it as **unverified**.
